text_block_list.text:
New Year came and went. Cesario tackled 
『Kanchiku Sho』――and emerged victorious!

(Great……!
Beat Triple Crown contenders over 
intermediate 2000m distance. With this……!)

Congrats on taking 『Kanchiku Sho』, 
Cesario. As expected,
your stamina and stride excel over longer
stretches.

Congrats on taking 『Kanchiku Sho』, 
Cesario. As expected,
your stamina and stride excel over longer
stretches.

Need another prep run before target 『Oka
Sho』. 
Let's test you at 1800m in 『Flower Cup』
next!

As for Kraft:
shorter distances let your burst shine. 
Entering you into 1400m 『Fillies' Review』.
choice_data_list: Let's work to our next goals!

text_block_list.text:
As for Kraft:
shorter distances let your burst shine. 
Entering you into 1400m 『Fillies' Review』.
choice_data_list: Let's work to our next goals!

text_block_list.name: Kraft & Cesario
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(After Fillies' Review comes 『Oka Sho』 next
month…… 
That'll be first time……clashing head-to-head
with Cesario 
in official match)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(First true all-out showdown against
Cesario……! 
Heart's pounding……can barely sit still……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Time to throw everything into training―― 
Wait, huh? ……Who's that over there……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa…… 
Here goes……――Haaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! ――Aaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Cesario?
Incredible……running shoulder-to-shoulder
with 
Special Week-san……legendary Golden Generation
senpai……?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not done yet, not yet……!
Yaaaaaaaaaa—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Spe-san……!
Fierce drive……hallmark kick of "Japan's
Supreme Commander"……! ……And yet――)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa――! 
Haaaaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Against that speed and pedigree!
Refusing to yield……! 
Constantly leveling up,
matching Spe-san step for step――)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Can I hold out from front against that? 
Facing a closing charge like that――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(No good!
"Looking forward to it"?
No time for naive excitement…… 
must step up my game!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(To withstand a late surge like that…… 
need weapon of my own……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Must train alongside someone with
overwhelming 
closing power too――……wait, that's it!

Hmm, hmm, hmmmmm~……♪ Busy,
busy witch at work. 
Now then, next spell reagents are~……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are……! 
Um, excuse me! ――Sweep Tosho-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for sudden request!
W-will you……! 
Will you run matching pace drills with
me?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Out of nowhere like that?
Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Instant rejection?!
P-please reconsider……! 
I desperately need to get stronger……!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No waaay. Sounds super boring. 
Besides, Sweepy is very busy right now!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eep……I-is that so? 
Uuu……b-but still, please hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do ears even work? 
Said NO! That means NOOO WAY!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please, just once! Help me out! 
I'm begging you, Sweep-saaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No means nooooo! Quit bugging me! 
What is wrong with you～～～～?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
――Fine! Put little blue flowers here,
and toss bulbs 
from that box into bottle over there.
Chop-chop!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right away! ……Um,
so once helping is done……!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine, fine! Just gotta run with you,
right? Geez…… 
Stubborn pest.
Arguing is more tiring than running!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, get told that often……sorry~. 
Now, blue flowers……and bulbs……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All set! ……Is this concoction 
prep work for massive new spell?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well,
magic circle vibe is definitely there…… 
Wait, you actually know about magic?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Of course……! Sweep Tosho-san. 
……You proved 『Magic on Turf』 is real.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Last year……before Triple Tiara campaign, 
you boldly declared: 『Boring world,
I'll rewrite it with magic』.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『"Triple Crown racers are stronger than
Triple 
Tiara racers",
is that what everyone thinks~?』

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『"Tiara racers always lose against Crown
racers in Senior grade, 
so logically Crown is superior"?』

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『What nonsense, so booooooring! 
Only total fools think like that!』

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『In that case,
Sweepy will show you! Starting with 
Triple Tiara sweep――』

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『Then onto Senior grade! Entering Grand Prix,
Takarazuka Kinen! 
I'll take down Triple Crown racers and
win!』

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『And cast great awakening magic on all you
dullards! 
Racing world isn't boring cage you built!』

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
『Triple Crown or Triple Tiara,
who cares?! 
Strongest is strongest!
I'll prove it to everyone!』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That interview……rewatched it countless
times. 
Over and over……stirred fire inside me every
single time.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
『Crown or Tiara doesn't matter』, 
『Strongest is strongest』……!
Believe that with whole heart. 
Want to prove it too. That's why……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please! Need to break limits now. 
To win 『Oka Sho』……to overcome my rival……!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh? ……Not just annoying pest, 
actually pretty fascinating girl.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Admitting you fell under Sweepy's brilliant
charm? 
……Can't let follower of mine stay weak,
then!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped! 
Sweepy grants your match race practice
request!

text_block_list.name: Kraft & Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaaa!
Yaaaaa————!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Kgh……! Not good……she's blowing past……!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew……! Not bad at all!
Quick break off mark, 
and held ground decently at home stretch.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-thank you very much. 
Still, you blew right past me at end……

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Facing Sweepy, obvious outcome! 
Debuted full year ahead of you anyway!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even so……! Not good enough. If I can't 
hold off closing burst like yours, then……!

text_block_list.name: Spe & Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaa……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Against that finish……that razor
sharpness!
If things stay like this……honestly,
no matter how far ahead I run,
it won't be enough……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I can't picture it!
I just can't picture winning against
Cesario……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
One more time……please, Sweep-san.
At this rate, I know it won't be enough……!
